generate_task_hash_all: run the script to compute and save hashes for all PHYRE templates to the task checksum file
generate_task_hash_specific: run the script with comma-separated template IDs to compute hashes for specific PHYRE templates only
load_and_hash_templates: load compiled PHYRE templates from the loader and compute their task hashes using phyre.util
update_task_checksum: update the existing task checksum JSON file with newly computed hashes for specified template IDs
review_main_function: review the main function that loads templates, computes hashes, and writes them to a JSON checksum file
